name: Carp Scales
description: Fish scales tucked row under row in a running bond, each scale two-toned with a darker heart inside its rim.

code.style: --rule: ( --j: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { width: 100%; height: 200%; z-index: @calc(100 - @y); -webkit-transform: translate(@calc(-50 * ((@y + 1) % 2))%, -25%); transform: translate(@calc(-50 * ((@y + 1) % 2))%, -25%); border-radius: 0 0 50% 50% / 0 0 50% 50%; background: radial-gradient(50% 100% at 50% 0%, @var(--j) 0 60%, transparent 60%) 0 100% / 100% 50% no-repeat, @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); :after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 100%; width: 100%; height: 100%; background: inherit; border-radius: inherit; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
